newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BROWN BROS RAISES AT&T.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BROWN BROS RAISES AT&T.

text.p: Brown Brothers Harriman analyst Robert Wilkes said he upgraded his short-term rating on AT&T Corp to a buy from hold, keeping a long-term market performer rating on the stock.
-- said investors are "starting to pay more attention to the fact that the earnings in the second quarter probably bottomed."
-- said naming of new chief executive could be perceived positively when it is announced.
-- said fundamentally stock is not expensive.
-- said changes among members of Federal Communications Commission could result in delays for regional telephone companies' entry into long distance.
